name: Skill India Mission
benefit: Free skill training in 300+ trades, government certification, placement support, ₹8,000 reward on certification
benefit_hindi: 300+ trades mein muft training, sarkari certificate, naukri mein madad, ₹8,000 inaam

eligibility.description: Any Indian citizen aged 15-45 years, school dropouts and unemployed youth
eligibility.description_hindi: 15-45 saal ka koi bhi Bharatiya naagrik, school chhodne wale ya berozgaar nojawan
criteria: No minimum education requirement for most courses
exclusions: Already enrolled in another government skill program

steps: Visit skillindia.nsdcindia.org or nearest PMKVY training center
Search for courses and training centers near you
Register with Aadhaar and mobile number
On passing, receive certificate and ₹8,000 reward
steps_hindi: skillindia.nsdcindia.org ya nearest PMKVY training center jaayein
Apne pass ke courses aur training center dhundhein
Aadhaar aur mobile se register karein
Pass hone par certificate aur ₹8,000 inaam milega

hindi_summary: Skill India mein muft training milti hai 300 se zyada trades mein — electrician, plumber, computer, beauty parlor, sab kuch. Certificate milta hai aur naukri lagwaane mein madad hoti hai. Pass hone par 8000 rupaye bhi milte hain.
